Universal-exposure measures with partial recourse place it in the elevated band.

No criminalisation, comprehensive anti-discrimination law covering sex characteristics, and hate-crime law covering gender identity. Documented offsets: ten logged violence cases without a denominator, uneven enforcement, parliamentary hostility, and a removed constitutional protection. Reduced-to-elevated boundary.
